nodes.label: The Website (public catalogue)
nodes.rationale: Sells nothing itself; every buy button opens the Product's Marketplace Listing.

nodes.label: One app, three Surfaces, one Supabase project
nodes.rationale: ADR 0008: Website at root, Member App under /app, Admin under /admin; Vercel Pro + Supabase Pro Singapore (ADR 0012).

nodes.label: No tenancy; Staff list keyed by email
nodes.rationale: Supersedes ADR 0005; every User is a Member, Staff Role owner/editor with invited/active/removed statuses.

nodes.label: Server-side access with RLS on and no policies
nodes.rationale: Drizzle connects with full access and the Staff Guard decides; browser publishable key reads and writes nothing. Replaces 'enforced by route Guards and RLS'.

nodes.label: Template cleanup (remove tenancy, email auth, demo screens)
Google OAuth only authentication
nodes.rationale: Authorization decided on the server from staff list and Member records, never client-settable metadata.

nodes.label: Service Seam everywhere
nodes.rationale: ADR 0003/0006: typed service modules, reads in Server Components, writes in zod-validated Server Actions; mock and database arms share a contract.

nodes.label: AYC design system tokens
nodes.rationale: Cream/navy/orange/blue tokens, hard offset shadows, Schibsted Grotesk + JetBrains Mono, light-only.

nodes.label: Catalogue seam
nodes.rationale: Mock-first typed seed behind a Catalogue service; becomes the new Reference Feature; reads cached and tagged.

nodes.label: Coming Soon rules
nodes.rationale: Excluded from counts, sorting, price filter, picker and ratings table; never show '₱0'.

nodes.label: Store button fallback (Listing → shop page → hidden)
Hand-entered Shopee figures and curated Reviews
nodes.rationale: No Marketplace API or scraping; Reviews never emitted as Review/AggregateRating structured data per Google's self-serving review rules.

nodes.label: Member App live switch
nodes.rationale: Hides every Member App CTA on the Website until flipped, with no code change.

nodes.label: SEO: sitemap, robots and JSON-LD without rating markup
Cookieless PostHog analytics
nodes.rationale: ADR 0009: anonymous, IP discarded, no person profiles, no consent banner; marketplace_click event.

nodes.label: Rendering and caching (nonce CSP, tagged Catalogue cache)
nodes.rationale: Per-request nonce CSP forces dynamic rendering, so speed comes from tagged caching at the Catalogue seam; Admin saves invalidate tags.

nodes.label: Middleware scope
nodes.rationale: CSP on every route but Supabase is called only for Member App, Admin and auth callback, so public pages avoid a Supabase round trip.

nodes.label: Two-stage Admin build (sample data, then database)
nodes.rationale: Every screen works on editable in-memory sample data first; Stage B adds database arms behind the same seams with the same behaviour tests.

nodes.label: Admin seam
nodes.rationale: Every write takes the acting Staff User and last-saved stamp, validates with zod, runs the conflict check, appends Staff Activity in the same transaction, returns cache tags.

nodes.label: Image upload via one-time upload URL
nodes.rationale: Browser uploads directly to avoid Server Action and Vercel request-size limits.

nodes.label: Environments: hosted Supabase for dev and prod, tests never touch it
nodes.rationale: DB tests and live-mode Admin e2e run only in CI against a throwaway local Supabase.

nodes.label: ADMIN_PASSWORD_SIGN_IN production switch
nodes.rationale: Temporary (ticket 24); server-only per-environment switch so turning off needs no code change.

nodes.label: Migrations (Drizzle schema as source of truth)
pnpm catalogue:seed
nodes.rationale: Refuses in production if data exists; after first load, the Admin is the only way to edit.

nodes.label: Staff Role permissions (Owner vs Editor)
nodes.rationale: Enforced on the server for every page and Server Action; last Owner can't be removed or demoted.

nodes.label: Live on save (no drafts)
nodes.rationale: Visibility toggles are the way to unpublish; no drafts or approval step.

nodes.label: Site pages editor (SEO + About)
nodes.rationale: Added 2026-11-05 for the contract's 'edit all content yourself'; blank means today's text so hosted DB needs no data loaded.

nodes.label: Summary for AI assistants (/llms.txt)
nodes.rationale: A proposed convention, cheap beside structured data, not a ranking promise.

nodes.label: Adding Exams and Subjects (Owner only, max 12)
nodes.rationale: An Exam code becomes a URL, menu item and Member App list entry, so adding one is a business decision for Owners.

nodes.label: Access decision seam allowed(member, content, device)
nodes.rationale: One server-side function called by every protected read; outcomes allowed, locked, expired, device-replaced, no device token, unavailable, not open yet.

nodes.label: Active Device
nodes.rationale: ADR 0011; device token is a random httpOnly cookie, only its hash stored; Admin sessions exempt.

nodes.label: Burned-in watermark on Reviewer PDF pages
nodes.rationale: Stamped on every request with sharp; no stored copies because they would grow with Members × pages.

nodes.label: Reviewer PDF background job
nodes.rationale: Resumable upload to private bucket, pdf.js ~25 pages per Vercel run, Cron restarts stale heartbeats; no AGPL MuPDF.

nodes.label: Spreadsheet import planner
nodes.rationale: Pure validator/planner; nothing saved until Staff confirm; imported content arrives Hidden.

nodes.label: Progress calculator
nodes.rationale: Pure functions over current-state study records, not an event log.

nodes.label: Beta gate and Beta Testers
nodes.rationale: Closed beta behind the Member App switch before Payments exist; testers matched by verified email like an Invite but no expiry or role.

nodes.label: Grants, extensions and End access now
Server-side quiz grading
nodes.rationale: Questions sent without correct choice or explanation so answers can't be read from the page.

nodes.label: Order ledger state machine
nodes.rationale: Pending→Paid/Failed/Expired, Paid→Refunded; idempotent per PayMongo event id; Paid is the only state granting access.

nodes.label: Phase 5 Video Courses
nodes.rationale: Provider must offer DRM, per-Member watermark, resumable 4 GB uploads; candidates VdoCipher, Mux, Bunny Stream.

nodes.label: Testing decisions (happy and sad paths through seam contracts)
Executer guardrails
nodes.rationale: Happy and sad paths tested; executer does not commit or push; lint, type:check, test, build must pass.
